g.text: 机组组合隔离比较 / UC isolated comparison
Synthetic development · 24 h · 264 vars / 48 binary / 480 rows
3 fresh processes/engine · 1 thread · call 30 s / supervisor 60 s / 4 GiB · medians include failed calls when measured
No warmup; process startup is separate in raw wall_seconds; missing times remain missing. No global ranking.
